title: Catan, read as a production floor
card: Dice to victory point in eight machines. The subject is a board game, so nothing here works because the material was already a pipeline in code.
lede: Eight machines turn two dice into a victory point. Every number on this page is from the base-game rules for 3–4 players, and the four states land on four things a Catan player already recognises — including the one that reports success over work it did not do.
handle: The robber is not a bad hex. The hex still rolls, the board still says it produced, and nothing arrives — which is the difference between broken and not built, and the whole reason two states are not enough.
source: numbers from the Catan base-game rules (3–4 player set): 19 hexes, 18 number tokens, 95 resource cards, 25 development cards, 10 VP to win.
